shared_elements: horizontal band or line spanning the surface
rows of short repeated strokes attached to a line (hatching / comb-like fringe)
schematic non-naturalistic linear motifs stacked in registers
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic geometric linework organised into stacked horizontal bands, and both include a line bearing a row of short repeated pendant strokes, but this is a generic device that any linear tradition could produce independently. The decisive difference is that A is an anthropomorphic figure — a head with facial features above a body bearing discs, loops and a belt-like band — whereas B is wholly abstract, showing only rectangles and comb-like fringed lines with no figure, face or disc.
